task: Issue 414 W8 real PG17 source reader benchmark

environment.pgVersion: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-windows, compiled by msvc-19.44.35228, 64-bit

methodology.source: real exported readers, current Staff session and Dashboard authorization
methodology.serial: 20 untimed warmup + 100 measured end-to-end transaction latencies per role/family/scenario
methodology.explain: exact candidate SQL captured without altering reader, EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON)
methodology.concurrency: 5 waves each at widths 4/8/16, shared Staff principal, includes locks/pool queue; descriptive only
methodology.syntheticData: two isolated Organizations, sparse/dense Location, ineligible recent and terminal history, off-location sessions
methodology.limitations: ephemeral local PG17 fixture; no ingress/network/staging, no production capacity or SLA claims

scenarios.label: sparse
scenarios.locationScope: single selected active Location; different Location noise
